text: What is a Unified Namespace?
reply:
A **Unified Namespace (UNS)** is a single, logical data model that aggregates all plant information—sensor streams, equipment metadata, work orders, and analytics—into one consistent hierarchy. Instead of siloed databases or protocols, every system (SCADA, PLCs, historians, MES, AI tools) reads from and writes to the same “namespace,” using standardized identifiers and formats. This eliminates data duplication, simplifies integration, and ensures that all users and applications see the same real‑time view of assets and processes. Think of it as a shared, organized folder structure for all industrial data, enabling faster decision‑making and smoother interoperability across the enterprise.
